title: PersonnelActionsContract
description: Administrator actions on one member (bans, warnings, membership grace) and the Discord role resync. The roster itself is personnel-roster.schema.json. The root is a ban state.

BanState.description: POST /api/v1/admin/users/:discordId/ban answers banned true; DELETE on the same path answers banned false. A ban revokes the member's live sessions.

BanRequest.description: POST /api/v1/admin/users/:discordId/ban body: the reason recorded on the account and in the audit log.

Warning.description: POST /api/v1/admin/users/:discordId/warnings answer (201): the recorded warning. issued_by is the administrator's Discord id.

MembershipGraceExtension.description: POST /api/v1/admin/users/:discordId/membership-grace answer: the member whose guild membership counts as current until expires_at.

MembershipGraceRequest.description: POST /api/v1/admin/users/:discordId/membership-grace body: a grace of 1 to 48 hours and its reason. Unknown keys answer 400.

RoleResyncOutcome.description: POST /api/v1/admin/roles/sync answer: how many members' website roles the Discord role mapping changed.
